summary: Worker-2 recovered the missing activity matrix from XML Table 2, worker-4 reconciled linked DBAASP rows while preserving target-strain and figure-only conflicts, and worker-6 closed the open rework ticket with cautions rather than hiding unsupported exact values.
adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair closed rwk-complete-test-0001. The paper is publication-grade accepted_with_cautions because hard blockers were repaired and remaining issues are explicit, nonblocking source-conflict cautions.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded re-review opened the local XML, extracted PDF text, OA images, supplement PDF/text, locator index, and linked DBAASP rows. Remaining gaps are nonblocking exact figure-data limitations recorded in unrecoverable_material_gaps.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Does not block publication-grade re-review because source-supported MIC/MBC rows, text-supported hemolysis values, and qualitative cytocompatibility context are recorded; exact database graph-derived values remain cautions.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Supplement S1 contains figure/caption material for MBC and membrane leakage time courses, not a parser-extracted numerical table. The exact MIC/MBC values needed for the gate are already available in XML Table 2.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking; S1 corroborates MBC workflow/figures but does not add recoverable row-level table values beyond Table 2.

per_layer_decision_rationale.final_decision: No blocking/major rework target remains after the bounded repair. Remaining limitations are explicit source-conflict cautions and nonblocking unrecoverable gaps.
